scenes.say: I open a new direct sales invoice for Donald Easter, on the retail price list. Prices on this list already include the tax.
Three iPad Air at three hundred each, and he gets ten percent off this line.
The line total is the quantity times the price, less the discount percentage. Three times three hundred is nine hundred, minus ten percent, eight hundred and ten.
Two cover cases at fifty, with no discount, make one hundred.
The sub-total adds up the lines. Shipping is zero here, so the amount total is the sub-total plus shipping: nine hundred and ten.
